newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 18.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 18.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Hungarian experts say there is no flood danger in the country despite the rainy weather.
- First flood aid to Poland will shortly leave Hungary.
- The President of opposition Christian Democrat Party will initiate the disbanding of the party's parliamentary group.
- Budapest Stock Exchange CEO Jozsef Rotyis will quit his post in the autumn.
- The Eenrgy Fund has received 600,000 requests for energy price compensations.
- A Rippl-Ronai painting was stolen from the Modern Hungarian Gallery in the south-west Hungarian town of Pecs.
- The supervisory board of privatisation agency APV said named four people as responsible for the Co-Nexus scandal.
